_readme: Where each value is stamped onto INFINITY RIO RANCH - Rental Agreement.pdf.
The template has NO form fields — the blanks are literal underscores in flat
text — so every value is drawn at a fixed coordinate. These numbers came from
the document's own text positions (pdfjs), not from eyeballing:
page 1 blanks are their own text runs, so x/y are taken straight from them;
page 4 blanks sit inside the label run, so x is the label's x plus the width
of the label text in Times-Bold at that size.
IF THE TEMPLATE IS EVER RE-EXPORTED, THESE ARE ALL WRONG AND NOTHING WILL SAY
SO — the values will simply land in the wrong place on a contract a client
receives. Re-run `node scripts/agreement-preview.mjs` after any change to the
PDF and look at the output before shipping it.
Origin is bottom-left, PDF points, page is A4 (595.32 x 841.92).
`y` is the baseline of the underscores plus a small lift so the text sits on
the line rather than through it. `maxWidth` is the blank's own width — longer
values are shrunk to fit rather than running over the neighbouring text.
Each field's `_from` is the measurement it was derived from, and `y` is that
run's y PLUS 3 — every field here, no exceptions. Keep `_from` truthful when
you move a value: it is the only record of which template a coordinate fits,
and it is what lets a wrong shift be undone. A set of page-1 values was once
moved down 14pt for a re-exported template; the template was later reverted
and the shift was not, so every name landed one line below its own blank.
The template is FIVE pages since section 3, Photos, Video & Social Media,
was drawn in as its own page between the Property Damage Waiver page and the
AGREEMENT/signature page. Nothing was reflowed and no existing text was
covered — the page was inserted, so every page-0 coordinate still holds and
the signature block simply moved from page index 3 to 4. Add a section the
same way again and `pageCount`, plus every field `page` at or after the
insertion point, has to move with it.
There is no `intro` block any more, and there should not be one again.
The template used to render its opening line as 'This Agreement is entered
into on this day of ________, 20, by and between:' — no day blank, no year
blank, sentence unfinished — so the code covered that line with a rectangle
and redrew it at run time. The corrected line is now baked into the template
PDF itself, so the run-time patch is gone.
DO NOT reintroduce it against this template. The cover rectangle spans
y 192.5-210.5, which reaches the second line but NOT the first at y 217.4 —
so a second pass would strike the first line twice and leave it visibly bold
while cleanly redrawing the second. `pageSize` and `pageCount` stay because
looksLikeKnownTemplate() in agreement.ts still reads them.

signatureClientName._from: run 'Client Name: ___…' at x=94.5 y=168.3 size 14; 'Client Name: ' is 83.2pt in Times-Bold@14. Page index was 3 until section 3 (Photos, Video & Social Media) was inserted ahead of it as page 4 — x/y are unchanged, only the page moved.
